question: Which Article deals with the election of the Vice President?
solution:
The Correct Answer is **__Article 66__.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Article 66

 
 
• Article 66 of the Indian Constitution deals with the election of the Vice President.
 
• The Vice President is elected by the members of an electoral college consisting of the members of both Houses of Parliament.
 
• This election process is indirect, as common citizens do not participate in it.
 
• The Vice President serves as the ex-officio Chairman of the Rajya Sabha (Council of States).
 
• The Vice President may act as the President of India in the absence of the President due to resignation, removal, death, or otherwise.
